newsitem.title: KUWAIT: October Kuwait air cargo volumes up 16 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: October Kuwait air cargo volumes up 16 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Kuwait airport cargo volumes rose 16 percent to 11,843 tonnes in October compared with the same month last year, official figures show.

Air cargo exports rose in October to 3,884 tonnes from 3,268 tonnes in October 1995. Imports increased by 14 percent during the same month to 7,959 tonnes, said a monthly study published in local newspapers on Saturday.
The number of passengers using Kuwait airport in October rose seven percent to 259,176.
The study said the national flag carrier Kuwait Airways Corp carried 62 percent of passengers and 68 percent of cargo.
